semantic_fragments.content: Damp heat test procedure: The sample is in normal working condition and put into the programmable constant temperature and humidity test chamber. The temperature and humidity of the test box are adjusted to 40°C and 95% RH. After the temperature and humidity are stable, it is maintained for 14.8 hours.

The test report pages 1 and 3 contain original page images for signature/stamp/photo verification. Page 3 contains attachment photos of the EUT (Equipment Under Test). The verdict field in the test result table is not populated in the available document content (marked as DRAFT).
